answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that must sign a fresh proof every epoch, and let standing harden slowly like cedar only as already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters; its trust stays a thin velvet film while honest standing accrues drop by drop like nectar. Honest pays one anchor once; a farm pays a distinct anchor plus a slow climb per head, cost linear with headcount.
